fact: The Observatoire de la qualité des services financiers du Togo (OQSF-TG), created by decree in September 2022 to handle bank-customer complaints, had still to deliver tangible results when the Council of Ministers called on 19 February 2026 for it to be made fully operational.
title: Togo Must Activate Its Financial Services Watchdog to Strengthen Consumer Protection (Op-Ed)
